profile.name: 环形区域图形组件
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件图形组件，用于在科学图像或谱图界面中定义、编辑和序列化环形区域。它通常用于交互式选择环形 ROI、生成掩膜或支持测量与分析显示，而不是直接控制任何实验硬件。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software graphic component used to define, edit, and serialize a ring-shaped region in scientific image or spectrum interfaces. It is typically used for interactive ring ROI selection, mask generation, and measurement/analysis display, rather than direct control of any laboratory hardware.
